title: LFP cathode composition and ultrasonic reducing leaching

steps.title: Identify the measured cathode feed
steps.question: What does the composition table describe?
steps.look: The table reports ICP-OES mass fractions for prepared LFP cathode material.
steps.boundary: These are not whole-battery mass fractions.

where.table_id: TABLE_Recycling of Spent LiFePO 4 Batteries Using Ultrasonic-Assisted Reducing Leaching_0001

steps.title: Inspect the treatment method
steps.question: Which process treats the prepared cathode material?
steps.look: Sulfuric acid and glucose are used for reducing leaching, with conventional and ultrasonic conditions.
steps.boundary: Conditions distinguish observations within the reported method.

steps.title: Read an elemental composition cell
steps.question: How much lithium was reported in this feed?
steps.look: The table reports Li at 4.36% by mass, alongside Fe, P and Al.
steps.boundary: Others is an aggregate, not an identified element.

where.semantic_ir_and_verification.table_id: TABLE_Recycling of Spent LiFePO 4 Batteries Using Ultrasonic-Assisted Reducing Leaching_0001

steps.title: Check the sample context
steps.question: What preparation defines this sample?
steps.look: Sample scope records cathode preparation, including the 450 °C, 2 h vacuum pyrolysis.
steps.boundary: Scope contextualizes the extracted sample; it does not create a recovery result.

steps.title: Check the method family
steps.question: How is the detailed method grouped?
steps.look: The leaching Process is grouped under acid leaching.
steps.boundary: A method family is a navigation category, not evidence that all its results are directly comparable.

steps.title: Connect feedstock to treatment
steps.question: What is the direct treatment input?
steps.look: The prepared cathode material is connected to the leaching Process.
steps.boundary: A whole battery is not substituted for the experimentally prepared input.

steps.title: Inspect a measured output
steps.question: What result is associated with the reported ultrasonic conditions?
steps.look: Li and Fe leaching results retain their conditions. Kinetic activation energies are excluded from material outputs.
steps.boundary: Compare only observations with suitable sample and operating conditions.
